records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Net sales increased $122,541,000, or 12%, to $1,144,579,000 in fiscal 2021 from $1,022,038,000 in fiscal 2020.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Operating income in our Retail Supermarkets segment increased from $23,202,000 to $25,914,000 for the year primarily due to higher volume.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: However, in periods of abnormally high production the amount of fixed overhead allocated to each unit of production is decreased to assure inventories are not measured above cost.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Our total bad debt expense was $338,000, $1,105,000 and $389,000 for the fiscal years 2021, 2020 and 2019, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Operating income in our Food Service segment increased from $6,458,000 in 2020 to $39,172,000 in 2021.
